title: Southern Norway Highlights | Oslo, Stavanger & Fjord Experiences
highlights: Experience one of the most scenic and steepest train journeys in the world, the Flam Railway, which passes through the King of the Fjords, Sognefjord.
Enjoy a thrilling hike to Pulpit Rock, resting gracefully above the Lysefjord and described as ‘one of the world’s most spectacular viewing points.
Explore some of Oslo's best attractions, like Oslo City Hall, Norsk Folkemuseum, and Aker Brygge, with the flexibility of Hop-on and Hop-off.
Enjoy a scenic train journey from Stavanger to Kristiansand, passing through amazing fjords and long tunnels and take-in the views of the surroundings.
overview:
About the tour:
With breathtaking fjords, stunning mountain ranges, quaint coastal towns and rugged coastline, Norway is indeed a place that came straight out of an artist's imagination. This 8-day Southern Norwegian Delights will start and end in the capital city, Oslo and take you to Bergen, in one of the most scenic and steepest train journeys in the world. Your astonishment wouldn't cease here, wait till you discover one of the most famous attractions of Norway, The Pulpit Rock, rising gracefully above the Lysefjord offering glorious views. From sailing amidst the fjords, riding the beautiful rails to exploring the quaint towns of Tvedestrand and Kristiansand, this tour to Southern Norway will give you an experience that will be etched in your memories for eternity.

know_before_you_go: Carry a form of identification, such as your passport or a government-issued ID as it may be required for certain activities or services.
It is recommended to carry an insulated jacket/warm clothes due to the cool northerly winds.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the premises of attractions.
Have some local currency for incidental expenses as not all places may accept foreign currency or cards.
Respect local customs and traditions, and follow any guidelines provided by tour guides or locals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrive in Oslo
days.desc: Welcome to Oslo! The largest and most populous city of Norway. Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. After you relax for some time, you can explore the city at your own pace by visiting places like the Akershus Fortress, Fram Museum, among many more attractions. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Tour
days.desc: Head out today to explore Oslo at your own pace. Reach the nearest pick-up point, and with the flexibility of the Hop-On and Hop-Off option, see some of the famous places in Oslo, like Frognerparken and Oslo City Hall, among many other attractions. Also, admire the beauty of the neighborhood and streets of the place and after an amazing exploration day, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Norwegian Museum of Cultural History, Oslo

days.title: Norway in a Nutshell Tour | Transfer to Bergen
days.desc: Prepare yourself for a memorable experience as you enjoy the Norway in a Nutshell tour. From the hotel, get transferred to Oslo station to board your train to Myrdal. After you board the train from Myrdal to Flam Village, enjoy the most scenic journey of the trip. Upon reaching Flam, head to the port on your own for your cruise to Gudvangen. After reaching, take a bus to Voss and then have a train journey to Bergen. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in AC Shuttle Bus
items.desc: 1 X AC Shuttle Bus will be Provided

items.title: Norway in a Nutshell Tour from Oslo to Bergen on a Shared basis

days.title: Transfer to Stavanger
days.desc: Enjoy a change of place as you get transferred from the hotel to the airport to board your flight to Stavanger. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. You may relax for the day or explore the city on your own by visiting famous places like the Stavanger Cathedral and Gamle Stavanger, among many more attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Pulpit Rock Cruise Experience
days.desc: Head today for an amazing journey to Pulpit Rock. Reach the pick-up point, Strandkaien, on your own to board the cruise, which will sail along the Lysefjord to the legendary Pulpit Rock, standing tall at 604m above sea level. Then, explore the historic Fantahålå and catch sight of seals basking on rocks. Lastly, admire the beauty of the stunning Hengjanefossen waterfall before you get transferred back to Strandkaien. From there, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Fjord Cruise to Lysefjord and Preikestolen from Stavanger

days.title: Train Journey from Stavanger to Kristiansand
days.desc: Enjoy a wonderful journey today toward Kristiansand, known as the children's city. Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the Stavanger station to board your train to Kristiansand. The train tracks may run close to the sea, offering panoramic views of the North Sea and nearby islands. As the journey progresses, see Norway's famous fjords and inlets, making it a trip to remember. Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel from the station and check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Train Journey from Stavanger to Kristiansand

days.title: Bus Journey from Kristiansand to Tvedestand
days.desc: Make way today for a wonderful bus journey from Kristiansand to Tvedestand. Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Kristiansand bus station to board your bus. Along the route, pass through charming coastal villages and towns, each with its own unique character and history. Continue the journey towards Lyngor, after which you will reach Tvedestand. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Bus Journey from Kristiansand to Tvedestand

days.title: Transfer to Oslo | Departure Day
days.desc: Its time to say goodbye to the beautiful landscapes and stunning attractions. After having breakfast, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Oslo Airport to board your flight back home. This is where your trip comes to an end.
